fusions.name: Bifurcate
fusions.desc: Throws a twig that deals 7 damage, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Root Delta
fusions.desc: Roots branch out under every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour, then fork on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Crown Splits Wide
fusions.desc: Your crown forks outward: for 15 seconds your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Split Grain
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a splinter forks off to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
